_comment: Object lifecycle for the POS Storage bucket — deletes payment-proof photos
15 days after upload so the bucket does not grow without bound.
APPLY WITH (once, per bucket):
gcloud storage buckets update gs://shareat-hub-v2.firebasestorage.app \
--lifecycle-file=storage-lifecycle.json
VERIFY WITH:
gcloud storage buckets describe gs://shareat-hub-v2.firebasestorage.app \
--format='value(lifecycle)'
NOTE 1: this is NOT deployed by `firebase deploy`. Lifecycle is bucket
configuration, not security rules, so it has to be applied separately and
will not be picked up by a normal deploy.
NOTE 2: matchesPrefix is a LITERAL prefix — no wildcards. That is why proof
photos live at paymentProofs/{storeId}/... rather than under
stores/{storeId}/, which would have made a single prefix impossible
without also matching store logos.
NOTE 3: this deletes the PHOTO only. The matching Firestore document is
deleted by a TTL policy on PaymentProof.expiresAt — see the type in
src/lib/types.ts. Both must be applied or one half survives the other.
NOTE 4: GCS evaluates lifecycle asynchronously, usually within 24h of the
condition being met. Expect deletion at day 15-16, not on the stroke of
day 15. Do not treat it as a hard guarantee for compliance purposes.
